reasoning_content:
The dist assets include .localConfigs.json (webpack copies the entire assets directory). But wait — the migration directory inside dist is... the backend runs knex migrations from `__dirname` (the dist folder). OK good.

Next, run the backend: `node dist/apps/startuphafen-backend/main.js`. Note that main.ts writes debug_config_output.json to assets (dist). No problem.

After that, check the DB migrations in the pg container.
